title: HQ reversion: long bx (pre-2025 re-pick)
question: Owner 2026-10-23: a strategy that trades 2+ times a week with high-quality, high-probability, high-profit setups - mean reversion at exhaustion (stretched range / both sides swept / stretched into a HTF pool / failed ORB).
verdict: $500 risk, costs in. H1: 24 trades (0.94/wk), true win 50.0%, PF 0.95, net -283 ($-46/mo), DD -1,385. H2: 12 trades (0.77/wk), true win 33.3%, PF 0.45, net -2,121 ($-571/mo), DD -2,575. 2025: 61 trades (1.18/wk), true win 49.2%, PF 0.91, net -1,337 ($-109/mo), DD -3,211. 2021-24: 207 trades (1.27/wk), true win 56.5%, PF 1.28, net +11,271 ($291/mo), DD -4,252. Evals (pass/fail-or-dead %): H1 25K alone 2-wk 0.0/0.0, next to LIT on the 50K 55.5/6.7; H2 25K alone 2-wk 0.0/0.0, next to LIT on the 50K 44.9/5.8; 2025 25K alone 2-wk 0.0/0.0, next to LIT on the 50K 12.9/1.2; 2021-24 25K alone 2-wk 1.5/0.0, next to LIT on the 50K 16.5/8.2.

rules: Box swept: the London 02:00-05:00 range; its high AND its low have both been traded through since the box closed; the second sweep by >= 0.25 x the 5m ATR; within 6 bars a 5m close back inside with a body >= 0.8 x ATR (displacement); entries until 12:00 ET.
Trade against the swept side (short after a high, long after a low) at the next 5m open + 1 tick; stop 1 tick beyond the extreme from the sweep to the signal bar (6-80 pts, else no trade).
Time exit 15:55 ET; one trade a day; $500 risk (floor(500 / (stop x $2)) micros, max 50); $1.90 a micro + 1 tick on entries, stop and time exits.

method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
